sn46.39:1.1: santi bhikkhave mahārukkhā anubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā yehi rukkhā ajjhāruhā obhaggavibhaggā vippatitā senti.
sn46.39:1.2: katame ca te bhikkhave mahārukkhā anubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā yehi rukkhā ajjhāruḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vippatitā senti. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn46.39:1.3: assattho nigrodho milakkhu udumbaro kacchako kapitthano.
sn46.39:1.4: ime kho te bhikkhave mahārukkhā anubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā yehi rukkhā ajjhāruḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vippatitā senti.
sn46.39:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco kulaputto yādisake kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti so tādisakehi kāmehi tato vā pāpiṭṭhatarehi obhaggavibhaggo vippatito seti.
sn46.39:2.1: pañcime bhikkhave āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhāruhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā.
sn46.39:2.3: kāmacchando bhikkhave āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhāruho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo.
sn46.39:2.4: byāpādo bhikkhave āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhāruho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo.
sn46.39:2.5: thīnamiddhaṃ bhikkhave āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso ajjhāruhaṃ paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ.
sn46.39:2.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhikkhave āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso ajjhāruhaṃ paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ.
sn46.39:2.7: vicikicchā bhikkhave āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhāruhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā.
sn46.39:2.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhāruhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā.
sn46.39:3.1: sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā anāvraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anajjhāruhā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti.
sn46.39:3.3: satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anajjhāruho bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati …pe… upekkhā …pe…
sn46.39:3.4: ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anajjhāruhā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattantīti.
